title: Reporting a Lost Item
meta: B2 · 约 280 词 · 场景：地铁站报失钱包

lines.en: **Excuse me. I think I left my wallet on the train about twenty minutes ago.**
lines.zh: 不好意思。我好像二十分钟前把钱包落在地铁上了。

lines.en: Oh dear. Which line were you on, and which direction?
lines.zh: 哎呀。您坐的是哪条线，往哪个方向？

lines.en: The Circle Line, heading towards HarbourFront. I got off here at Buona Vista.
lines.zh: 环线，往港湾方向。我在这里波那维斯达站下的车。

lines.en: Right. Can you ==describe== the wallet for me?
lines.zh: 好的。能描述一下钱包的样子吗？

lines.en: It's a black leather ==bifold==, quite worn at the corners.
lines.zh: 是个黑色真皮对折钱包，四个角磨得挺旧的。

lines.en: And what was inside?
lines.zh: 里面有什么？

lines.en: My employment pass, two bank cards, and about eighty dollars in cash.
lines.zh: 我的工作准证、两张银行卡，还有大概八十块现金。

lines.en: Have you ==cancelled== your bank cards yet?
lines.zh: 银行卡您挂失了吗？

lines.en: Not yet. __I'll do that__ right after this.
lines.zh: 还没有。这边弄完我马上就去办。

lines.en: Good idea. I'll file a report and alert the other stations. Can I have your name and ==contact== number?
lines.zh: 好的。我来登记报失，并通知沿线其他车站。能留一下您的姓名和联系电话吗？

lines.en: Lee Wei, and my number is nine eight seven six, five four three two. __Feel free to__ call anytime.
lines.zh: 李伟，电话是九八七六，五四三二。随时可以打给我。

lines.en: Thanks. Here's your ==reference== number. If it turns up, we'll give you a call.
lines.zh: 谢谢。这是您的报失编号。如果找到了，我们会给您打电话。

lines.en: Hello, is this Mr Lee? It's Ryan from Buona Vista station. Someone handed in a black wallet at HarbourFront.
lines.zh: 你好，是李先生吗？我是波那维斯达站的 Ryan。有人在港湾站交了一个黑色钱包。

lines.en: **Oh, that's great news! Is everything still inside?**
lines.zh: 哦，太好了！东西都还在吗？

lines.en: The cards and the pass are there, but I'm afraid there's no cash.
lines.zh: 卡和准证都在，不过现金恐怕没有了。

lines.en: Ah well, I'm just relieved about the pass. Replacing it would have been a ==nightmare==.
lines.zh: 唉，算了，准证还在我就放心了。要补办的话可就麻烦死了。

lines.en: I understand. You can ==collect== it at the HarbourFront ==control station== until nine tonight.
lines.zh: 理解。今晚九点前您可以去港湾站的车站服务中心领取。

lines.en: **Do I need to bring anything? My ID was actually in the wallet.**
lines.zh: 需要带什么吗？我的证件其实就在钱包里。

lines.en: Your passport will do, plus the reference number I gave you.
lines.zh: 带护照就可以，还有我给您的那个报失编号。

lines.en: Perfect. __Is it okay if__ my wife picks it up instead? I'm stuck at work.
lines.zh: 好的。我太太代我去领可以吗？我在公司走不开。

lines.en: She'd need a signed ==authorisation== letter from you, plus a copy of your passport.
lines.zh: 她需要带一封您签字的授权书，再加一份您的护照复印件。

lines.en: Got it. Then I'll just go myself after work. Thanks so much for calling.
lines.zh: 明白了。那我下班后自己去吧。非常感谢你打电话来。

lines.en: You're welcome. Glad it turned up.
lines.zh: 不客气。找到了就好。

gist.q: 「你」把钱包落在哪里了？钱包长什么样，里面有什么？
gist.a: 落在环线往港湾方向的地铁上；黑色真皮对折钱包，四角磨旧，里面有工作准证、两张银行卡和大约八十块现金。

gist.q: 工作人员找回钱包时说了什么情况？
gist.a: 有人在港湾站交了钱包，卡和准证都在，但现金没了。

gist.q: 去领钱包要带什么？太太能不能代领？
gist.a: 带护照和报失编号；太太代领需要「你」签字的授权书和护照复印件，所以「你」决定下班自己去。

dictation: Excuse me. I think I left my wallet on the train about twenty minutes ago.
My employment pass, two bank cards, and about eighty dollars in cash.
Do I need to bring anything? My ID was actually in the wallet.
Perfect. Is it okay if my wife picks it up instead? I'm stuck at work.

prompts.q: 你在出租车上落下了孩子的水壶和外套，打电话给出租车公司。说清乘车时间、路线和物品特征，并留下联系方式。
prompts.ref: Hi, I took one of your taxis this afternoon, around three, from Holland Village to Novena. I think I left a bag in the back seat. It's a small blue backpack with a kid's water bottle and a grey jacket inside. I paid by card, if that helps you find the driver. My number is nine one two three, four five six seven.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我今天下午三点左右坐了你们的出租车，从荷兰村到诺维娜。我好像把一个包落在后座了。是个蓝色小背包，里面有一个儿童水壶和一件灰色外套。我是刷卡付的，也许能帮你们找到司机。我的电话是九一二三，四五六七。

prompts.q: 你在商场丢了手机，去客服台求助。说清最后在哪里用过、手机的样子，问他们会怎么处理。
prompts.ref: Hi, I think I lost my phone somewhere in the mall. The last time I used it was at the coffee shop on the second floor, maybe half an hour ago. It's a black phone in a clear case with a sticker of a cartoon dog on the back. Has anyone handed one in? If not, could you take my details and call me if it turns up?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我好像在商场里把手机弄丢了。最后一次用是在二楼的咖啡店，大概半小时前。是一部黑色手机，透明壳，背面贴了一只卡通小狗贴纸。有人交过来吗？如果没有，能留下我的联系方式，找到了打给我吗？

words.ex: Can you describe the man who took your bag?
I prefer a slim bifold to a big wallet.
I called the bank to cancel my credit card.
Please leave a contact number at the front desk.
Quote your reference number when you call back.
Getting a new passport abroad is a nightmare.
You can collect your parcel from the locker downstairs.
Ask at the control station if you need help with your card.
You need written authorisation to collect someone else's mail.
